items.title: Meta Andromeda: Powering the Next Generation of Ads Retrieval Through Model-System Co-Design
items.summary: This post describes the next generation of Meta Andromeda, Meta’s personalized ads retrieval engine, and how co-designing the model, system, and GPU hardware unlocks a new efficiency frontier for ads retrieval.
